name: HouseCart — household groceries & receipt splitting
description: Mobile-first web app for shared households: scan grocery barcodes (real Open Food Facts lookup -> name + product image) or add items manually with a photo; photograph a receipt and OCR it in-browser (Tesseract.js) into line items; pick WHICH items to split and who shares each one; tax allocated proportionally; settle up via one-tap Venmo charge links; per-household spending tracking over time.

real: Open Food Facts product lookup: name, brand, size, image
Receipt OCR via Tesseract.js running client-side
Receipt line-item parsing + per-item split math + proportional tax
mocked: Google sign-in — renders the REAL Google Identity Services button when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is filled in; falls back to a demo identity picker until Kaylee creates the Cloud Console client
Persistence is localStorage (per-browser), not a shared server DB
